title: 喵有此理 · 猫喝完水，下巴为什么是干的
character: needle-felted American Shorthair cat, silver tabby with dark classic swirl markings, round amber eyes, tiny white lab coat with two buttons, visible wool fiber texture, handmade miniature puppet
style: handmade needle-felt stop-motion miniature diorama, visible wool fiber texture, soft warm studio light, shallow depth of field, tactile handmade feel

shots.narration: 你有没有发现，猫喝完水，下巴是干的？
shots.motion: the felt cat sits still beside the bowl, blinks once slowly, then tilts its head toward the camera

first_frame.composition: medium shot, cat centered, bowl in lower third
first_frame.subject_state: sitting upright beside a small ceramic water bowl, looking straight at camera, ears forward
first_frame.environment: miniature felt kitchen counter, tiny felt window with warm morning light behind

last_frame.composition: medium shot, same framing, slightly closer
last_frame.subject_state: head tilted to one side, eyes half closed mid-blink, chin visibly dry and clean
last_frame.environment: same felt kitchen counter, same warm light

shots.narration: 狗喝水像拿勺子舀，溅得到处都是。猫不是。
shots.motion: a felt dog scoops water with a cupped tongue, water splashes outward onto the floor

first_frame.composition: medium shot, dog on the left, bowl on the right
first_frame.subject_state: a needle-felted golden retriever lowering its head into a water bowl, tongue curled upward like a ladle
first_frame.environment: miniature felt kitchen floor, felt water droplets scattered around the bowl

last_frame.subject_state: the felt dog lifting its head, muzzle and chest soaked, felt water droplets flying outward
last_frame.environment: same felt kitchen floor, a wet patch of darker wool spreading around the bowl

shots.character_override: needle-felted golden retriever puppet, shaggy honey-coloured wool, floppy ears, visible wool fiber texture, handmade miniature

shots.narration: 猫的舌头根本不伸进水里，只有舌头背面碰一下水面，然后高速往回抽。
shots.motion: the cat's tongue extends downward, curls backward so only its upper surface touches the water, then begins to retract

first_frame.composition: extreme close-up, profile, water surface along the lower third
first_frame.subject_state: the felt cat's head lowered, tongue extending straight down toward the water, tongue tip curled backward
first_frame.environment: surface of water in a small ceramic bowl, rendered as smooth translucent resin with felt texture beneath

last_frame.subject_state: the upper surface of the tongue just kissing the water surface, no part of the tongue submerged, a dimple forming on the surface
last_frame.environment: same bowl, a shallow dimple where the tongue touches

shots.narration: 水被惯性拽着跟上来，立成一根柱子。
shots.motion: the tongue pulls up fast and a slender column of water follows it upward, stretching thinner as it rises

last_frame.subject_state: the tongue high above the surface, a thin glassy column of water stretched between tongue and bowl
last_frame.environment: same bowl below, the column catching the warm light

shots.narration: 就在重力把这根柱子扯断的前一刹那——嘴，合上。
shots.motion: the mouth closes over the top of the water column, the lower part of the column breaks and falls back into the bowl

last_frame.subject_state: mouth closed, chin and whiskers completely dry, a single felt droplet falling back toward the bowl
last_frame.environment: same bowl, ripple spreading where the droplet lands

shots.narration: 每秒 3.5 次，舌尖 78 厘米每秒，一次 0.14 毫升。
shots.motion: the cat sits up beside a small felt chalkboard as three handwritten figures appear on it one by one

first_frame.composition: medium shot, cat on the left, chalkboard on the right
first_frame.subject_state: the felt cat sitting upright in its lab coat, one paw raised toward a miniature chalkboard
first_frame.environment: miniature felt laboratory corner, tiny felt beakers on a shelf, warm light

last_frame.subject_state: the cat holding the pose, looking at the board with a satisfied expression
last_frame.environment: the chalkboard now covered in three lines of chalk figures and a small sketch of a tongue and water column

shots.narration: 一次都不多，一次都不少。
shots.motion: the cat turns from the board toward the camera and gives one small precise nod

last_frame.subject_state: facing camera, one slow deliberate nod completed, eyes steady and confident
last_frame.environment: the felt laboratory corner softly out of focus behind

shots.motion: the cat leans slightly toward the camera and its whiskers lift into a small satisfied expression

last_frame.composition: medium close-up, cat centered, space at the top for a title card
last_frame.subject_state: leaning toward camera, whiskers raised, a small pleased expression, chin still perfectly dry
last_frame.environment: the felt laboratory corner behind, warm light, soft vignette
